Every link worked in priority order (money-corner first, then CHOKE_POINT, then remaining chain position) against the mapping's ACTIVE-but-un-audited census (no top-level `audit` block exists on data/mappings/arctic-sea-route.json; six 2026-09-14 fresh-context `--placement` audits exist instead). Per-link account:

ice-class-propulsion-systems [MONEY CORNER, CHOKE_POINT]: 2 ROWS WRITTEN (WARTSILA, KONGSBERG), bucketed picks_and_shovels. Both carry a current PASS placement_audits[] entry dated 2026-09-14 and a fresh COMPLETE O2 profile built for this exact chain/link. ABB REFUSED despite also carrying a PASS placement_audits[] entry on this link: ABB's only profile on disk (data/companies/ABB.json, status COMPLETE, data_tier T2) resolves listing_refs ['OTC-ABBNY'] and carries placements only for chain_id ai-infrastructure (power-equipment, grid-interconnect); it names no arctic-sea-route placement and no SIX-ABBN listing, even though the mapping's own SIX-ABBN listing and a fetched data/market/ABBN-SW.json both exist. Seating ABB here would attribute an OTC-ADR-listing profile's USD-denominated fundamentals to a row identified by the SIX Swiss primary listing (ABBN, CHF) the profile never resolves -- a wrong-listing defect the campaign-v1 identity rule exists to refuse, even though check_screen.py's mechanical gate does not itself cross-check a profile's own placements[] array against the row's link_id (see the 2026-09-14 MITSUBISHI-HEAVY-INDUSTRIES finding in tasks/backlog.md, bucket profile-multi-chain-gap, same root cause). Fix is `run profile ABB` adding the SIX-ABBN listing_ref and an arctic-sea-route/ice-class-propulsion-systems placement over data/market/ABBN-SW.json; captured to tasks/backlog.md rather than chased in this run. GE-VERNOVA REFUSED: its sole placement_audits entry FAILed 2026-09-14 (role_ok false, source_date_ok false -- the cited Magnetics Magazine article never names the Arctic Offshore Patrol Ships class the role claims), its lone evidence item is INFERRED not VERIFIED, and its own profile (data/companies/GE-VERNOVA.json, T1, listing_refs ['NYSE:GEV']) carries no arctic-sea-route placement either.

polar-marine-hull-and-war-risk-insurance [MONEY CORNER]: 1 ROW WRITTEN (BEAZLEY), bucketed picks_and_shovels (the capital/underwriting layer around the transit, not the transit itself). BEAZLEY carries a current PASS placement_audits[] entry and a fresh COMPLETE O2 profile. LANCASHIRE-HOLDINGS REFUSED: its sole placement_audits entry FAILed 2026-09-14 (role_ok false, source_date_ok false -- the cited Ship Universe 'Top 12' page, fetched twice this audit, names neither Lancashire nor Hiscox anywhere in its current body text), its lone evidence item is INFERRED not VERIFIED, and its own profile (data/companies/LANCASHIRE-HOLDINGS.json, T2, listing_refs ['LSE-LRE']) carries no arctic-sea-route placement. CHUBB, MARKEL-GROUP and ALLIANZ are all COMPLETE O2 profiled (CHUBB T1, MARKEL-GROUP T1, ALLIANZ T3; ALLIANZ's profile even carries a matching arctic-sea-route/polar-marine-hull-and-war-risk-insurance placement) but every one rests on a single INFERRED evidence item with no placement_audits entry, which the campaign-v1 audit_scope:PLACEMENT rule over an un-audited mapping refuses without either an all-VERIFIED evidence set or a current PASS placement audit; none has been sampled for them. Re-evidencing or a fresh-context placement audit, not more profiling, is what would seat these three.

russian-arctic-lng-export [CHOKE_POINT]: 1 ROW WRITTEN (CNOOC), bucketed second_order (a minority, once-removed equity claim on the cargo rather than the operator or an enabling supplier). CNOOC's single evidence item is VERIFIED (Mitsui's own 2019 investment-decision release), clearing the audit_scope:PLACEMENT all-VERIFIED bar with no placement audit needed. NOVATEK, TOTALENERGIES and MITSUI are all COMPLETE O2 profiled with matching placements on this exact link but each rests on a single INFERRED evidence item (TASS, Rigzone/Moscow Times, and an S&P Global 2019 release respectively) with no placement_audits entry, so none is admissible this run -- notably NOVATEK itself, the project operator and the cargo owner every other link on this chain exists to move, insure and berth, is not seated for exactly this reason: its identity/role evidence has never been audited in fresh context, only INFERRED-tagged from a TASS report.

No placement exists to screen.

ice-class-classification-and-notation [HIGH bottleneck]: 1 ROW WRITTEN (BUREAU-VERITAS), bucketed picks_and_shovels (a regulatory/certification gatekeeper enabling every vessel on the route to sail).
